overall.verdict: Mobile dark has a real product spine—hero totals, indigo Pay, bilateral notch bars, frame/proof receipts—but it is not yet a calm fintech surface: legends, chips, hex, faucet CTAs and swap-open spam fight the money. Visceral value is honored on Home/Account/Sovereignty and abandoned on receipts, activity, Move truncation and Lending.
priority_fixes: One receipt component (Pay sheet = Activity sheet): signed amount, frame, proof+copy, Done; drop ms latency.
Home: delete Secured $0 and the 1px=$100 sentence; one bar caption; no hub chip.
Move FROM/TO as full-width rows with untruncated amounts and a filled Sign & send; never clip 1,500.00 US…
Activity: cluster open swaps; bars on sent/received only; stop clipping Accou chips.
Indigo fill only for money commits (Pay, Sign & send, Done). Faucets, Offer-to-pool, Copy invoice, disabled Swap are outline or hidden. Hard-empty Lending when there is no API.
